name: Graphite
why: Battery anodes, nuclear fuel matrix and neutron moderator

name: Reinforced carbon-carbon
why: Survives re-entry heating on leading edges and nose caps

name: Phenolic-impregnated carbon ablator (PICA)
why: Lightweight ablative heat shield for high-speed re-entry (Stardust, Dragon)

name: CVD diamond
why: Highest thermal conductivity material for heat spreaders and windows

name: Carbon (elemental feedstock)
why: Carbon for steelmaking, carbides and carbon fibre in space

name: Carbon fibre
why: Highest stiffness-to-mass fibre for structures and pressure vessels

name: Carbon-fibre reinforced polymer
why: Light structures, COPV overwraps and composite tanks

name: Carbon nanotube fibre
why: Candidate tether and structural fibre; bulk strength far below single-tube values
